description: Publishes a board config: it is certified (thousands of test rounds price its odds) and goes live, usually within a minute. stakeOptions: up to 6 amounts in increasing order, 0 or 100..5000. maxPlayers (2..12) also opens multiplayer rooms for it. Waits up to 45 s; if it's still certifying, check with game_status.

maxPlayers.description: Optional: make it multiplayer for up to this many players

replaces.description: Optional: configHash of your own board to update (within 24 h of making it)

name: publish_luck_board
title: Publish a luck board
